about.en: AXIS is the token of Axis Robotics (also called Axis AI), a project building a distributed data engine for physical AI and robotics, where human contributors teleoperate robots in large-scale simulations and the resulting demonstrations become training data for foundation models. The token is an ERC-20 on Base at 0x5bE75e3b0aFf5D1A042A5363Ae36AcB1d6d755ea and is used to reward contributors.
